evals.prompt: Mira esta pagina https://example.com/landing la quiero en HTML para estudiarla, es mia
evals.expected_output: Pregunta alcance (solo pagina / subenlaces / sitio), luego clona a clon/ con index.html + styles/ + scripts/ + assets/ y check_links en verde
expectations: Asks the scope question before cloning
Produces clon/ with index.html, styles/, scripts/ and assets/
check_links passes on the cloned output

evals.prompt: Te paso este link https://example.com/app replica este dashboard en Astro, solo la pagina principal
evals.expected_output: Sin pregunta de alcance (ya dicho: solo principal + framework Astro), port en src/pages/*.astro con astro build en verde
expectations: Does not repeat the scope question because scope and framework were already given

evals.prompt: Bajame todo este sitio https://example.com/ completo con imagenes
evals.expected_output: Mapeo desde raiz con map.json, descarga con todas las imagenes, layout clon/ completo y reporte de pendientes
expectations: Maps the site from the root and writes map.json
Downloads every image referenced by the pages
Reports what could not be downloaded
